title: citrus × aurantiifolia subsp. latifolia
intro: Citrus × aurantiifolia subsp. latifolia, commonly known as the Philippine lime or key lime, is a plant species that is a subspecies of the citrus × aurantiifolia. This plant has been used for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as a digestive aid, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The Philippine lime has therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of the Philippine lime include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
